Class DatabaseSettingStore

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.spring.setting.DatabaseSettingStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.sca4d.core.api.setting.access.SettingReader<String>, com.sca4d.core.api.setting.access.SettingWriter<String>
public class DatabaseSettingStore extends Object implements com.sca4d.core.api.setting.access.SettingReader<String>, com.sca4d.core.api.setting.access.SettingWriter<String>
按 owner 和规范编码读写 sys_setting，保留来源版本及敏感值用途绑定。
